title: 🔆🔅Deputy Head of Lebanon’s Supreme Islamic Shiite Council Meets with Iran’s Foreign Minister
text:
🔆🔅Deputy Head of Lebanon’s Supreme Islamic Shiite Council Meets with Iran’s Foreign Minister"

"Sheikh Ali al-Khatib, Deputy Head of Lebanon’s Supreme Islamic Shiite Council [parliament], met with Iran's Foreign Minister, Seyyed Abbas Araghchi, on Friday evening, August 28th. "

"Sheikh al-Khatib is leading a delegation to take part in the 40th Islamic Unity Conference.
